title: Should You Buy Pinterest Stock Before the Huge Investor Update?
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc reiterates Pinterest as a BUY ahead of its 29 October earnings and investor update, keeping it in his top ten stocks to buy in 2026; he owns the stock. The shares trade over $22 (stated), up from a $15 low this year but still down 14% year to date against an S&P 500 up over 10%, and the valuation is near all-time lows at a 9.3x forward P/E against analyst expectations of EPS growth over 27% a year. His base case is improving fundamentals: Pinterest is one of the few social platforms still adding North American users, who carry the highest advertising revenue per user, its users skew young so revenue per user should rise as they age, and operating margin is 6.3% and improving even after stock-based compensation. On timing, he suggests risk-neutral buyers put 75% of their intended allocation in before the print and 25% after, and risk-averse buyers split 50/50; Meta's strong advertising results are a positive read-across. The bear case is execution: research and development runs at over 29% of revenue — higher than Meta, Snap and Reddit — with little product innovation to show for it, and revenue per employee has fallen from its roughly $900,000 peak in 2022.
